programs.name: Welding Technology
programs.blurb: Hands-on training in cutting and welding processes used across construction, energy and advanced manufacturing.
programs.what: The Welding Technology program builds real shop skills in SMAW, GTAW, MIG and pipe welding, plus blueprint reading and metallurgy. Graduates leave ready for high-demand fabrication and construction careers across eastern North Carolina — employers regularly recruit straight from our shop.
next: Apply to PCC online — free, about 20 minutes.
Complete the FAFSA — welding students often qualify for workforce scholarships.
Tour the welding shop and meet your advisor.

programs.name: Associate in Arts (University Transfer)
programs.blurb: Complete your first two years at PCC, then transfer seamlessly to a four-year university.
programs.what: The Associate in Arts is a university-transfer degree covering the first two years of a bachelor's program. Under North Carolina's Comprehensive Articulation Agreement, your credits transfer to any UNC System university — at a fraction of the cost.

programs.name: Associate in Science (University Transfer)
programs.blurb: A STEM-focused transfer path toward engineering, science and health-related bachelor's degrees.
programs.what: The Associate in Science emphasizes math and lab science coursework that transfers to UNC System universities, positioning you for majors like engineering, biology, chemistry and pre-health tracks.

programs.name: Associate Degree Nursing (ADN)
programs.blurb: Become a registered nurse in five semesters through clinical rotations with regional health partners.
programs.what: PCC's ADN program prepares you to sit for the NCLEX-RN and enter practice as a registered nurse. You'll train in simulation labs and complete clinical rotations with hospitals and providers across the region.
eligible: High school diploma or equivalency with required coursework
Competitive admission — points-based selection each spring

programs.name: Dental Hygiene
programs.blurb: Clinical training in preventive oral health care, delivered in PCC's on-campus dental clinic.
programs.what: Students train in a fully equipped on-campus clinic serving real patients, graduating eligible for national board examination and state licensure as dental hygienists.
eligible: High school diploma or equivalency with required coursework
Competitive admission — application window each spring
Observation hours in a dental setting

programs.name: Radiography
programs.blurb: Learn diagnostic imaging with clinical experience in hospitals across eastern North Carolina.
programs.what: The Radiography program combines imaging science coursework with extensive hospital-based clinical education, preparing graduates for ARRT certification.
eligible: High school diploma or equivalency with required coursework

programs.name: Emergency Medical Science
programs.blurb: Train as a paramedic with field and clinical experience alongside regional EMS agencies.
programs.what: From EMT fundamentals through paramedic-level care, this program pairs classroom instruction with ambulance and emergency-department rotations.

programs.name: Business Administration
programs.blurb: Practical management, marketing and operations skills for running or growing a business.
programs.what: Business Administration covers accounting, management, marketing and business law — flexible enough to finish fully online while you work.

programs.name: Information Technology
programs.blurb: Networking, cybersecurity and support tracks aligned to industry certifications.
programs.what: The IT program offers concentrations in networking, cybersecurity and technical support, mapped to certifications employers ask for — CompTIA, Cisco and more.

programs.name: Paralegal Technology
programs.blurb: Prepare for work in law offices, courts and government agencies as a qualified paralegal.
programs.what: Learn legal research, drafting and case management from practicing attorneys, preparing for the NC State Bar paralegal certification exam.

programs.name: Criminal Justice Technology
programs.blurb: A foundation for careers in law enforcement, corrections and public safety.
programs.what: Coursework spans criminal law, investigations, ethics and corrections — a strong foundation for public-safety careers or transfer to a four-year criminal justice program.

programs.name: Electrical Systems Technology
programs.blurb: Wiring, motors and controls — skills that took a PCC student to the SkillsUSA national podium.
programs.what: Train on residential, commercial and industrial electrical systems, including motor controls and programmable logic controllers. PCC students compete — and medal — at SkillsUSA nationals.

programs.name: Air Conditioning, Heating & Refrigeration
programs.blurb: Install, service and maintain the systems every building in the region depends on.
programs.what: Hands-on HVAC training covering installation, diagnostics, refrigerants and energy-efficient systems, with EPA 608 certification preparation built in.

programs.name: Early Childhood Education
programs.blurb: Start a career shaping young learners in child care, pre-K and early education settings.
programs.what: Prepare to work with children from birth through age eight, with pathways toward NC birth-through-kindergarten licensure and transfer options.

programs.name: Truck Driver Training (CDL)
programs.costNote: Short-term workforce training. State scholarships can cover most or all of the cost.
programs.blurb: Earn your Class A CDL in weeks and step into a high-demand driving career.
programs.what: An intensive behind-the-wheel program preparing you for the Class A CDL exam, with employer connections for immediate placement.

programs.name: Nurse Aide I
programs.costNote: Short-term workforce training. State scholarships can cover most or all of the cost.
programs.blurb: A fast, affordable first step into health care — and a springboard toward nursing.
programs.what: Train for state listing as a Nurse Aide I in a single semester, with clinical experience in local care facilities. Many students continue into PCC's nursing programs.
